Product incubator | REMOTE (US) | Consulting (1099)

We are a small team with a wide network, bringing ideas to market with a focus on simplicity and trust. Clients a mix of early-stage and enterprise. Seeking long-term collaboration with imaginative people who communicate well.

Teams are built around projects. At the moment, looking for the following:

- Experience in F&B logistics, pickup/transport/scheduling systems, price monitoring, banking integration, mobile shopping tools and redundancy for a neat client.

- Experience in local models/compliance/alignment at MA/PhD level for preventative medical AI client.

Otherwise, there's more in the pipeline so feel free to reach out now or in the future.

As a consultant, collaboration could be anything from periodic advisor to dedicated contributor.

As for technology, pragmatic - best tool for the job. Rough consensus and running code.

Based in NYC, with clients and team beyond the US. We've got a life to live.

Under wraps due to client, but otherwise transparent and operate in good faith.

Email in profile.
